rule_name: Choose smaller YOLO variant for latency-first use
adjustment_value: Prefer nano or small variants before larger variants within the same YOLO family.
notes: Inferred from official benchmark tables where smaller variants generally have lower latency/compute; use as a suggestion rather than a hard rule.

rule_name: Choose larger YOLO variant for accuracy-first use
adjustment_value: Consider medium, large, or xlarge variants if hardware and latency budget allow.
notes: Inferred from official benchmark tables where larger variants generally have higher mAP50-95; use as a suggestion rather than a hard rule.

rule_name: Use automatic batch sizing for limited VRAM
adjustment_value: Use automatic batch sizing such as batch=-1 or a CUDA memory fraction when available.
notes: Directly supported by Ultralytics configuration/train documentation describing automatic batch-size estimation.

rule_name: Use time limit when training time is constrained
adjustment_value: Set a maximum training time; time-based training can override epoch-based training.
notes: Directly supported by Ultralytics configuration documentation describing the time training argument.

rule_name: Tune hyperparameters if target metric is not met
adjustment_value: Run hyperparameter tuning with a chosen evaluation metric and tuning budget.
notes: Directly supported by Ultralytics hyperparameter tuning guide.

rule_name: Consider increasing image size for accuracy-first use
adjustment_value: Consider increasing image size if hardware allows and validation performance improves.
notes: Partly supported by image size being a configurable training/prediction parameter that affects compute; this is a tradeoff rule, not an explicit Ultralytics prescription.

rule_name: Consider reducing image size for latency-first use
adjustment_value: Consider reducing image size if latency or compute is more important than accuracy.
notes: Partly supported by image size being a configurable training/prediction parameter that affects compute and latency; this is a tradeoff rule, not an explicit Ultralytics prescription.

rule_name: Consider YOLOv10 for NMS-free low-latency detection
notes: Supported by YOLOv10 documentation describing NMS-free inference and latency-oriented motivation; actual speed depends on deployment hardware and export format.

rule_name: Prefer YOLO11 for stable Ultralytics deployment
notes: YOLO11 is an official Ultralytics model family; preference for stable deployment is a recommendation-level interpretation supported by official YOLO11 documentation and YOLO12 production cautions.

rule_name: Use YOLO12 cautiously for production
adjustment_value: Community-driven model maintained primarily for benchmarking and research; possible training instability, elevated memory consumption, and slower CPU throughput.
notes: Directly supported by Ultralytics YOLO12 documentation.

rule_name: Increase cls_pw for class imbalance
notes: Multiplies penalty for missing a minority class target.

rule_name: Maximize mosaic and imgsz for tiny objects
notes: Forces network to train on artificially smaller objects without losing resolution.

rule_name: Increase weight_decay and HSV for overfitting
notes: Penalizes large weights to force generalization and reduces memorization of colors.

rule_name: Increase warmup_epochs for early NaN loss
notes: Allows random initial weights to settle gently before full learning rate kicks in.

rule_name: Set close_mosaic for clean final predictions
notes: Disables heavy spatial augmentations in the final 10 epochs for clean bounding boxes.

rule_name: Heavily augment small datasets
notes: Artificial variance is required when natural variance is missing.

rule_name: Decrease augmentation for massive datasets
notes: Prevents underfitting when natural dataset variance is already extremely high.

rule_name: Increase max_det for crowded environments
notes: Bypasses the hardcoded 300-object limit in default NMS logic.

rule_name: Linearly scale lr0 when changing batch size
notes: Linear scaling rule for mini-batch SGD/Adam to prevent divergence.

rule_name: Enable early stopping to save compute
notes: Prevents wasting GPU hours on a model that has stopped improving. Standard heuristic is patience=50 when epochs=100 to 300.
